name: Bereft Hills
subtitle: Wilderness
body: The bereft hill are shunned by locals for a good reason. Strange things wander these parts, the walls of Modbury seem too frail hold the flood of nightmares from the region.

name: Caeraotrom Athenæum
subtitle: Oghma's Blessing
body:
On the eastern slope of Mount Lerosia in the Wolf's Teeth mountain range, stands the massive citadel of Caeraotrom which has endured the elements for centuries and defied the degradations of time. Visible for miles around, Caeraotrom has an eye-catching silhouette: a high wall interspersed with towers. This wall encloses a large space from which more towers rise.

The entrance to Caeraotrom is a double gate that stands at the end of the thousand-step road, the only road that provides access to and from the outside world. The route follows a lonely path along the mountainside where Caeraotrom stands.

Those who gain entry discover a cloistered community of scholars milling around inside Caeraotrom's walls, a place of enlightened conversation and friendly debate. No better place in the Realms exists for those who have a love for or a need of knowledge and who want to pursue such interests alongside fellow seekers.

Caeraotrom has the largest repository of written lore in Eraldom, including the collected prophecies of the great sage Ereor Menolas. Those compiled divinations make up a tiny fraction of the accumulated knowledge and secrets contained in the library's vast collection.

Not all knowledge preserved in Caeraotrom is of historical importance. The library holds thousands upon thousands of lost recipes, old songs, collections of folklore, and journals written by folks whose time has long since passed. The abundance of these ancillary works makes finding notable tomes an exercise in patience and perseverance. Fortunately, a legion of scholars and sages called the Avowed look after the library and remain vigilant in the care and cataloging of all the knowledge it holds.

name: The Alabaster Palace
subtitle: King's Estate
summary: Eperina's seat of power, on the cliff of Brightend.
body: The seat of power in Brightend. From here, the King oversees the distribution of resources across the vale.

signature.name: Ham's Special Candy Cane
signature.desc: A rock hard candy cane that will survive many licks.

name: Warden Fort
subtitle: Headquarters and barracks
body: The epicenter of law enforcement and military power in Brightend. The elite military corp is respected through the whole country.

name: Oddmoss Librarium
subtitle: Ancient tomes and dusty books
body: One of the finest bookshops in the region, known by scholars for their dedication to procuring old and rare volumes.

name: Brawn & Brawn Agency
subtitle: Nimo and Gust's mercenary agency
body: A small office tucked neatly between two impressive homes in the Cloud District houses the yound mercenary agency. Already hired by the Crown, the agency sees itself becoming a staple of the city.

name: Gilded Goldfinch
subtitle: The finest drinks and eats the city has to offer
body: The finest inn in the city... or the country, according to owner Merton Lensher. No other place be to socialize, enjoy a nice meal or eavesdrop on the newest rumors.

signature.name: Goldfinch Reserve
signature.desc: Amber mead aged in the cellar; Merton pours it himself.

signature.name: The Lensher Roast
signature.desc: Whatever Merton deems worthy today. Ask.

name: Thayne Household
subtitle: Where the traumatized widower lives.
body: We all know what happened here... it's like zombies were done to the cupboard. The poor Thayne widower, now sole owner of Finest Cloth still resides in this house, desperately awaiting the return of his departed wife. The house itself still feels inhabited by the magic responsible for her disappearance.

name: Finest Cloth
subtitle: Where the best fabric is!
body: Late Elira Thayne's tailor shop. Only the best materials, coming from all over the continent, assembled by the best seamstresses!

name: Turris Magi Finisclari
subtitle: The Archamge's Tower
body: The Turris Magi is one of the highest building in the cloud district, second the Alabaster Palace. It is a landmark known by all but feared by most. As a place of magic most people shun it and some even avoid it.

name: The Fighting Pits
subtitle: Danger Zone
body: Underground arenas where disputes are settled in blood and illegal wagers are the city's true currency.

name: Harbour Master
body: Where the master habours... or something

name: Oxana's Gems
subtitle: Jewelry Emporium
body: Oxana's Gem stands tall and proud as the oldest jeweler in Brightend. This 4th generation shop is famous through out the city, and even further...

name: Black Rose Inn
subtitle: Fresh Water, Warm Beds, Decent Wine... sometimes
body: The coolest and edgiest inn in town.

tavern.hours: Dawn to midnight; later if the wine holds out

signature.name: Deercrest Venison Stew
signature.desc: The town's pride, simmered since morning.

name: The Stoat and Cellar
subtitle: Poor, but cozy
body: A cozy tavern, if a poor one, in the scrap-built town of Silverbrook. It is owned by Rowan Larkspur, a tattooed halfling. Like the rest of Silverbrook, it is patchwork of ruined old structures, scavenged scraps and newer furniture. Usually a lively place, it is one of the largest constructions in the city, spanning over 2 floors and is the social center of the settlement.

signature.name: House Mull
signature.desc: A hot mulled drink, and the only reason to brave winter here.

signature.name: Mermaid's Tears
signature.desc: A flavorful shot meant to help you mend a broken heart. Or just forget it.

name: History Wing
subtitle: Order of the Lens
summary: Also known as H-wing, it is the place Order of the Lens Sages spend the most time in.
body: The History Wing, also known as the H-wing contains everything thing about the history of the Realms, as well as workspaces for Historian Sages of the Order of the Lens.

name: Great Readers Office
subtitle: Administrative and Scholarly Department
summary: Filled to the brim with books and reports, the room feels cold, yet soothing.
body:
Caeraotrom maintains a council of eight Great Readers, senior Avowed who oversee day-to-day operations. These erudite scholars and gifted spellcasters are chosen from the ranks of Master Readers. Each is acknowledged as Caeraotrom's foremost expert on a particular area of study. Many of them use the Master Sage stat block presented earlier in this section.

As of now, the Great Readers are:

- A'lai Aivenmore, an elf master sage and worshiper of Oghma. Primary expertise: divinity (the gods and the nature of the divine).
- Alkrist, a bronze dragonborn master sage. Primary expertise: politics, military strategy, and significant battles of Maltona.
- Derrek Yashenti, a human master sage and poet. Primary expertise: music, poetry, and literature.
- Fheminor Scrivenbark, a lightfoot halfling master sage. Primary expertise: history, folklore, and the cultures of Eraldom (past and present).
- Erin Nyantani, a human master sage. Primary expertise: the natural world and celestial navigation.
- Sylvira Savikas, a tiefling archmage. Primary expertise: the Planes of Existence.
- Telos Ahvoste, a human archmage. Primary expertise: magic items, curses, and Ethyria.
 - V'ziir-Ag, a githzerai master sage. Primary expertise: all things unnatural (including aberrations, undead, and the Void).
